The '''Biker Advanced Recon Commando (BARC) speeder''' was a powerful [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] model used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as a reconnaissance craft during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was manufactured by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]]. A civilian variant, [[RapidResponse police speeder/Legends|Police BARC speeder]] also saw extensive use on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Characteristics==
Younger than the [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]] employed at the Second Battle of Dorin, it was actually more closely designed after the [[Ripper (speeder bike)/Legends|Ripper]] manufactured by Aratech's competitor, [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet]].

[[File:BARCrancorsidecar-Kidnapped.png|thumb|left|220px|A BARC speeder with attached [[side-car]]]]
Originally designed for exclusive use by the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]], the vehicle proved so effective that it came to be used by the rest of the army.<ref name="db" /> These speeders were painted in the red-and-white colors of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

They were powered by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] and a turbine engine mounted on the frontal prong. The speeder was controlled via twin steering vanes atop the bike, and pedals fitted below. Two [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] cannons protruded from the bottom of the forward prong, while two more were fixed on either side of the vehicle's rear. 

The vehicle’s key advantage—and the reason it became popular with many planetary police forces—was its reliability: it required minimal maintenance and rarely showed signs of damage. <ref name=":0">[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide|''Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide'']]</ref>

The speeders were capable of flying at high altitudes and were sometimes used as escorts for [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] carrying important passengers.

===Variants===
Variants of the BARC speeder included the [[RapidResponse police speeder/Legends|RapidResponse police speeder]] used by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="SWBftG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> the [[BARC speeder (two-person)|two-person BARC speeder]],<ref name="LEGO">{{LEGOWeb|subdomain=starwars|url=en-us/products/classic/7655.aspx|text=Star Wars Clone Troopers Battle Pack|nolive=1}}</ref> and the BARC command vehicle also used by [[Biker Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Biker Advanced Recon Commandos]] during the Clone Wars and later by [[Officer/Legends|officers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The BARC command vehicle had a slightly different design with a more massive front part and two vanes pointing forward.<ref name="SWG:NGE">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:BARCspeeder2-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|A BARC speeder used to transport a wounded clone trooper]]
During the conflict, BARC speeders were produced in the millions for both military and police use.<ref name=":0" /> Around the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]]<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a variant of the BARC speeder was used by [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Police droid/Legends|police droids]]. The only apparent differences from its military counterpart was that it had a dark blue/gray paint job and had flashing red and blue lights near the aft thrusters and stern thruster. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] rode a police droid's BARC speeder to a train station to catch [[Ione Marcy/Legends|Ione Marcy]] and [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]], following the signal of a homing beacon placed on Marcy's back by Sinube.<ref name="ll">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> Another time when police droids rode these was when it appeared that [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] had murdered [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]], and these were used to follow a civilian airspeeder, which the [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]] thought she was escaping in.<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>

Jedi Master [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] once flew a BARC speeder during the initial stages of the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], using it to transport her and [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] to the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor's]] residence to see [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to safety. In the aftermath of the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo]] and his wingman, astride BARC speeders, executed [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by firing the bike's blaster cannons on [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Stass Allie's speeder, killing her.

[[File:BARC_comm.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Due to the BARC speeder's rise in popularity, they became commonly used by many clone troopers.]]
During a mission to capture [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], Presidente of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and Clone Commander [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] were assisted in the assault on the Presidente's headquarters by a squad of [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]] troopers riding BARC speeders. Aided by [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]], these elite biker troops defeated [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] during the battle.

Troops under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] later rode their speeders into combat on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], moving alongside [[Infantry Support Platform/Legends|Infantry Support Platforms]] and [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernauts]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

Following the war, BARC speeders continued to be used by the early [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], although they were seemingly phased out afterward, and replaced with the older 74-Zs for military use. 

The [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] employed the BARC speeder for reconnaissance and hit-and-fade missions conducted by its scout units. Despite institutional pressure to adopt the 74-Z, many scouting units continued to operate BARC speeders during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name=":0" />

On Kashyyyk, many speeders were left behind, following the formation of the Empire, and were used during the Galactic Civil War by native [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and visiting [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. Some others, also obtained from Kashyyyk, came into the hands of some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] for personal use. During the Galactic Civil War, BARC speeders were also utilized by various groups, although they often required a deed as proof of ownership. Several of these BARC speeders were also given custom paint jobs.<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> Besides civilian use, the BARC command speeders also had two variants, one for Galactic Empire personnel use, and another for Rebel Alliance personnel usage. Regardless of the faction, both require their members to be Colonel-class before obtaining one.<ref name="SWG:NGE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CommandBarcs.jpg|thumb|150px|An Imperial Command Barc (top) and a Rebel Command Barc (bottom)]]
The BARC design was developed using the precedent of the [[74-Z speeder bike|Imperial speeder bikes]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. Though they are showcased on [[Saleucami]], they can also be seen on [[Coruscant]] and were designed for use in the forests of [[Kashyyyk]]. Initially, [[Stass Allie]] was to be riding a BARC speeder, but to provide a greater link to the original trilogy, a more recognizable 74-Z speeder bike was used instead.<ref name="db" />

Seven BARC speeders have been released by LEGO, one in 2005, two in 2011, one in 2013, one in early 2014, one in 2020, and one in 2021. The first one was featured in the Clone Turbo Tank. The second and variant comes in two other sets (Clone Trooper Battle Pack and Battle for Geonosis). The fourth variant is featured in a set with a Confederate speeder, with the sidecar attached. The fifth variant is featured with the set Battle on Saleucami, which has a new spring-loaded firing mechanism, the sixth variant is featured in the set 501st Legion Clone Troopers, the seventh variant appeared in the Bad Batch Shuttle, and is virtually identical to the 2020 version other than color.
